'''Mawhonic's Podracer''' was a [[Galactic Power Engineering/Legends|Galactic Power Engineering]] [[GPE-3130 Podracer/Legends|GPE-3130]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] owned and operated by [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]]. Parts for the vehicle were scrounged from [[Wald's Parts|Watto's junkshop]], including a pair of secondary thrusters affixed to the conical [[Engine/Legends|engines]].<ref name="Podracer" />
